name: Example table: peak depths of simulated storms
description: The peak water depth at a river gauge in each of 50 simulated storms, for a 10-, 50- and 100-year storm. One of nine example tables that illustrate ways to chart a comparison of scenarios, each row's scenario in its case column. The Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons test dataflow draws it as a strip of ticks per storm, with its median. Curio's seeded script scripts/build_example_scenario_charts.py writes it.
